title: How a canoe helped turn Hawaiian culture into a source of pride and even influenced Hollywood
version: Associated Press anniversary report, KSAT syndication, 8 March 2025
lineage: AP reports and captions identifying the credited historical photographs. The saved HTML retains the textual captions, not downloaded images. The day and exact start of training are not claimed. The contemporary 1976 Outrigger account provides an independent participant description of a year of practice under sail.
